• Inference stays on this device; no cloud fallback.
• Chat stays in memory; closing chat clears it.
• Web search sends generated queries to Tavily; Wikipedia sends a generated topic to the selected language edition. Either may include chat details; the full transcript is never uploaded.
• Downloads need internet. Your keyboard and external apps may also use internet.
• Chat button hidden: press Space on idle Home to open chat.\n• The assistant must stay enabled.

• Open: on idle Home, Space opens chat without adding text (assistant must be enabled).
• Keys: Enter or Send submits; Shift+Enter adds a line. Back closes and clears chat; Home minimizes and keeps it in memory.
• Chat cannot operate the phone; punctuation, including !, is ordinary text.
• Type / for commands (/web, /wikipedia, /health, memory). Tap + for Web search, Wikipedia or Health; tap × for neither. Selection persists through submits and Home; clearing chat restores Web search.
• The model picks a query or primary topic and language, up to twice per reply; queries may contain chat details.
• Web failures warn that an offline answer is unverified.
• Wikipedia: finds an introduction and reads up to two selected sections within two retrieval calls. Excerpts may be partial; headings are navigation, not evidence.
• Answers use only text retrieved for that reply, with article, contributor and license links. Missing evidence gives an inability-to-verify message, never an offline answer.

• Home keys: on idle Home, @ message, # call, + calendar draft, ! alarm/timer, ? app search (if enabled). No assistant or model needed. In editors, these characters are ordinary text.
• Floating to-do: - or Alt+T (Titan 2 Elite types - with Alt+I).
• Floating note: , or Alt+N/Alt+A. Needs the Notes app; Grace stays on Home. Enter saves nonblank text.
• Notes: type a new note and press Enter to save, or tap an existing title (arrows then Enter also select). Selecting clears the input; type the text to append and press Enter. No existing note is selected by default.
• Message/call: type a contact or address; grant contact permission for lookup.
• Call: Enter or a tap calls immediately after any required phone permission; if unavailable or denied, the dialer opens instead.
• Message: Enter selects; type the body and press Enter to continue.
• WhatsApp/Business: selections stay separate; synced phone contacts first, recent conversations only when sync data is unavailable. Lists may be empty or incomplete; membership is not checked live.
• Calendar: +meeting 30 nov at 9am or +meeting nov 30 at 9am. The opening + opens the panel; type the rest inside.
• Dates (English): day + named month or named month + day, abbreviated or full, optional ordinal and four-digit year. No year uses the next occurrence; date only means all-day; timed events default to one hour in the local time zone.
• Calendar opens a draft for review and saving. Invalid dates need review; nothing is saved automatically.
• Alarm/timer: after !, type an English command (alarm 7:30am, wake me at 7, timer 10m), then Enter.
• Timers: 1 second to 24 hours (30s, 5min, 2h, 1h 30m).
• Alarm hours: unqualified 1–12 chooses the nearest upcoming AM/PM time; use am/pm or a leading-zero hour (07:00) for a literal time. Check today/tomorrow in the preview. A named day must match Clock’s next occurrence; later dates are refused.
• Navigation: arrows select results; Tab/Shift+Tab move focus; Enter continues; Shift+Enter adds a line.
• Escape, Back, or Home clears the command. Returning from another app retains an unfinished draft in memory only.
• SMS: messaging normally opens a provider draft. Automatic direct SMS is off by default and needs the assistant role and SMS permission; confirm the exact number for inferred recipients. SMS is queued, not confirmed delivered; uncertain sends are not retried. Premium short codes may cost extra.
• Space opens assistant chat when enabled.
